styles.name: projectile

styles.name: pendulum
styles.description: Pendulum: pivot rides a ceiling beam to progress; rod and solid bob swing θ₀·cos(ωt) beneath

styles.name: mass-spring
styles.description: Mass-spring SHM: x=A·cos(ωt) — coil compresses/extends, amplitude grows with progress

styles.name: newtons-cradle
styles.description: Newton's cradle: five touching balls in a frame; the end balls trade swings, base fills with progress

styles.name: orbital
styles.description: Kepler orbit: planet with a circling moon sweeps an elliptical path around a pulsing star; orbit traced = progress

styles.name: terminal-velocity
styles.description: Terminal velocity: v=v_t·(1−e^(−t/τ)) plots toward its asymptote while a falling body's drag arrow grows to match its weight

styles.name: elastic-collision
styles.description: 1D elastic collision: cart A→B, momentum swaps — three phases: approach, impact, separation

styles.name: gravity-well
styles.description: Gravity well: spacetime grid sheet dips into a funnel around a mass; a test particle spirals in with progress

styles.name: light-cone
styles.description: Light cone: hourglass of past and future cones through the here-now plane; future cone and worldline grow with progress

styles.name: double-slit
styles.description: Double slit: plane waves hit a two-slit barrier, ripples interfere, and the screen's cos² fringes build with progress

styles.name: doppler
styles.description: Doppler effect: a source drives across with progress; its circular wavefronts bunch up ahead and stretch out behind
